gloss: divine will; destiny; heaven's mandate; natural lifespan

definitions.explanation: one's fate or destiny as determined by heaven or divine forces
the natural span of life given to a person by heaven

examples.japanese: {天命|てんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全|まっと}うする→全うする：11651_mattousuru⟧。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天命|てんめい}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}って→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れた→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧。
examples.english: I accepted it, believing it to be destiny.

examples.japanese: ⟦{五十|ごじゅう}→五十：00930_gojuu⟧にして{天命|てんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: At fifty, one comes to understand heaven's will.
examples.notes: Famous saying from The Analects of Confucius

notes:
{天命|てんめい} refers to destiny as ordained by heaven.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{天|てん}→天：28464_ten⟧: Heaven, sky
- {命|めい}: Life, command, destiny

FAMOUS CONFUCIAN SAYING:
⟦{五十|ごじゅう}→五十：00930_gojuu⟧にして{天命|てんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧
"At fifty, one understands heaven's will."
From the Analects of Confucius, describing the stages of life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天命|てんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全|まっと}うする→全うする：11651_mattousuru⟧ (to fulfill one's destiny/live out one's natural life)
- {天命|てんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧ (to understand one's destiny)
- {天命|てんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (to await one's fate)
- {天命|てんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧ (to follow destiny)

PHILOSOPHICAL CONTEXT:
Rooted in Confucian and traditional East Asian thought where heaven determines one's purpose and lifespan.
